newsitem.title: USA: Sen. Lott sees U.S. balanced budget pact by March.
newsitem.headline: Sen. Lott sees U.S. balanced budget pact by March.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Tuesday he expected an agreement by March on a plan to balance the budget, and also a vote on the constitutional balanced budget amendment by the end of February.

"I expect the balanced budget amendment to the constitution to be voted on by the end of February," the Republican from Mississippi told reporters. "And hopefully an agreement on the blanced budget plan, that we hopefully can come to an agreement with the president on, would be reached sometime in March, and that we will pass something through here by the Easter recess which is in the middle of March."
